title: CSF Opening Pressure: Context and Interpretation
subject: CSF & Fluids
preview: CSF opening pressure is measured during lumbar puncture under standardized patient positioning and technique.
quickRevision: CSF opening pressure is measured during lumbar puncture under standardized patient positioning and technique.
Evaluate pressure alongside CSF cells, glucose, protein and appropriate microbiology tests.
